changes.comment: Adds benchmarks for the diff, subscription matching and end-to-end emit, with a committed baseline and a comparison script. Reporting rather than gating, since the variance on a shared runner is not yet characterised and a benchmark gate that fails intermittently is one people learn to bypass.\n\nThe first run answered two open questions and raised one. Wildcard subscription matching is linear in the number of registered patterns — 0.54 µs at one, 241.8 µs at a thousand, against a flat 0.19 µs for exact delivery. Subscribers are not what a commit costs: fifty on untouched paths cost what zero cost, and an instrumentation observer adds about three percent. And normalised collections are cheaper to reorder but more expensive to update than the arrays they replace, because the diff enumerates an object's keys where it indexes an array — the entity adapter documentation now says so with the numbers rather than implying it wins outright.
